Both hands are raised to the sides of his face, with index fingers pointing towards or lightly touching his cheeks, creating a cute, shy, or mischievous gesture. The clean, solid white background emphasizes Pocoyo's vibrant colors and expressive pose, making him stand out as a fun and engaging sticker.
